tasks.name: 创建笔记数据库模型
实现笔记API
创建笔记前端页面
实现笔记搜索功能

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database schema with tables for notes, including fields for title, content, timestamps, and user associations.
T1.notes: Consider using a relational database like PostgreSQL for structured data management.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on notes using a framework like Express.js or Django.
T2.notes: Ensure proper authentication and authorization mechanisms are in place.

T3.implementation_approach: Create a responsive web interface using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks like React or Vue.js to interact with the notes API.
T3.notes: Focus on user-friendly design and seamless integration with the backend.

T4.implementation_approach: Implement a search functionality using full-text search capabilities or third-party services like Elasticsearch.
T4.notes: Optimize for performance and accuracy in search results.

file_structure.purpose: Defines the Note database model with fields id, title, content, created_at, and updated_at.
Implements CRUD API routes for managing notes, including create, read, update, and delete operations.
Initializes the Flask app, sets up the app factory, and registers the notes blueprint.
Entry point for the Flask application, responsible for running the app.
Provides the frontend interface for managing notes, including forms for creating, editing, and deleting notes, as well as a list view.
Defines the CSS styles for the notes management frontend page.
Extends the notes API to include a search endpoint, allowing users to search notes by title or content.
